tests.title: parses hard and alg with named and positional options and refuses every libm type, oversampling and unscoped syntax with exact messages
mirrors the C float types: threshold rounds to float before 1/threshold and the double gain product, param rounds to float
clips hard samples exactly at the threshold boundaries and keeps zero and negative zero
negotiates fltp for u8, s16, s32 and flt input and dblp for dbl input, with the native list and no rate conversion
plans unchanged counts and packet sections and reserves one output frame
matches the C transcription for hard and alg over the option grid in float and double, packed and planar, and is frame-split invariant
converts integer input to fltp exactly as the float transcription of the converted samples
enforces allocation limits, refuses non-finite input and observes cancellation
checks the pinned native reference build
matches native asoftclip type=hard over the threshold, output and param grid on every source format byte for byte
matches native asoftclip type=alg over the threshold, output and param grid on every source format byte for byte (linux/x64)
matches native asoftclip hard in composed chains with frame splits, positional options and output time selection
refuses every libm type, oversampling and unscoped options before writing output, where native succeeds or fails

details: 675 byte comparisons for type=hard: 27 option sets (threshold {1,0.5,0.001} x output {1,1.3,16} x param {0.01,1,3}) x 5 sources (u8, s16le, s32le, f32le, f64le stereo with zero, negative zero, clip boundaries, full scale) x 5 outputs (raw f32le, f64le, s16le, s16 WAV -bitexact, pcm_f32le framecrc), -cpuflags 0
675 byte comparisons for type=alg, same grid, gated to linux/x64 build-metadata

180 framecrc byte comparisons of composed chains (asetnsamples splits, volume, adelay, apad, aformat, two asoftclip steps), positional options, output -ss/-t/-frames:a, f32 and s16 output, on all 5 sources

15 native exit-status checks for refusals (12 where native succeeds: 7 libm types, default tanh, oversample=2 for hard and alg, enable, exponent value; 3 where native fails: out-of-range threshold, param, oversample), each refused by us with unsupported-filter and no output file

unsupported: option expressions, exponents, suffixes and integer type values
non-finite input samples and alg inputs that overflow to infinity
alg parity on platforms other than linux/x64 (fused arithmetic on macOS arm64)

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 48s, npm ci 11s, reference:build 3m49s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1m07s, baseline unit 1m36s.
The alg differential test title carries the gate: on non linux/x64 builds it is skipped with the reason in its title.
Verified the comparison has teeth: rounding gain from the double threshold instead of the float threshold makes both grid tests fail.
Final unit failures are exactly the baseline ones (FLAC artifacts blocked by downloads.xiph.org, resample-checkpoint goldens recorded on macOS arm64).
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
